marketplace.empty_mine: Nothing published under your name yet. Your first package or wallpaper is one click away.
marketplace.hero_title: Built by people who use this app
marketplace.hero_body: Plugins, skills and wallpapers, published by the community and installed in one click. Anyone can publish — sign in with GitHub, and whatever passes the automated checks goes live under your name.
marketplace.identity_signed_in_hint: Everything you publish from this app appears under this name.
marketplace.identity_publishes_under: your packages publish under this name.
marketplace.identity_sign_in_blurb: Sign in with GitHub to publish. The sign-in only proves who you are — it grants nothing on your account.
marketplace.identity_unreachable: GitHub is unreachable right now — your sign-in state could not be checked.
marketplace.identity_dialog_subtitle: One code, typed at GitHub. No password ever reaches this app.
marketplace.identity_code_hint: Open GitHub, paste the code, and approve. This app picks up the result on its own — nothing else to do here.
marketplace.identity_requesting: Requesting a sign-in code from GitHub…
marketplace.identity_fact_scope: The sign-in asks for no permissions on your account — it only proves who you are.
marketplace.identity_fact_name: Everything you publish appears publicly under your GitHub name.
marketplace.identity_fact_keyring: The token stays in your system keyring. Sign out removes it.
marketplace.studio_rail_note_public: Anyone can publish. Whatever passes the automated checks goes live without human review, publicly under your GitHub name.
marketplace.studio_rail_note_rules: Installing users see exactly what your package would be allowed to do before they accept it.
marketplace.studio_disabled: Publishing is disabled in this deployment — no publish endpoint is configured.
marketplace.studio_source_hint: what is inside decides whether it becomes a skill or a plugin card
marketplace.studio_door_folder: Drop a package folder — or a single SKILL.md
marketplace.studio_door_folder_hint: Drag the folder or the file here, or click to choose a folder. plugin.json, mcp.json and bundled skills are read automatically; a lone SKILL.md becomes a skill. Nothing is uploaded until you press Publish.
marketplace.studio_door_github_hint: Browse your public repositories, pick the package, review it first.
marketplace.studio_door_blank_hint: Write it in the form — best for a single skill.
marketplace.studio_door_wallpaper_hint: Drop a picture or pick one of your own — the community can add it in one click.
marketplace.studio_how_step_1: Sign in with GitHub — it only proves who you are.
marketplace.studio_how_step_2: Add your package: drop the folder, import it from GitHub, or write it here.
marketplace.studio_how_step_3: Check it — the exact rules the store enforces run before you submit.
marketplace.studio_how_step_4: Publish. The checks re-run, it merges on green, and appears in the store within minutes.
marketplace.studio_how_show_layout: What does a package folder look like?
marketplace.studio_how_layout_note: Names are lowercase a-z 0-9 - . and the first published claim owns the name. No credentials in any file — tokens are placeholders like $plugin_…, filled in on the user's machine at connect time.
marketplace.studio_github_note: Public repositories only — you review everything before publishing. No token is used here; this only reads public files.
marketplace.studio_github_no_repos: This account has no public repositories.
marketplace.studio_github_truncated: GitHub cut this listing short — this repository is large enough that the scan may have missed a package outside what is shown here.
marketplace.studio_err_scan_truncated: This repository is too large to scan fully, and no plugin.json or SKILL.md turned up in what GitHub returned — try a specific subfolder instead.
marketplace.studio_err_scan_empty: No plugin.json and no SKILL.md in this repository — nothing here is a publishable package.
marketplace.studio_err_ref: Enter a repository as "owner/name" or paste its GitHub URL.
marketplace.studio_wallpapers_hint: only pictures you brought yourself — an installed community wallpaper is somebody else's work
marketplace.studio_wallpapers_empty: No pictures of your own yet — drop one above, or add one in the Wallpaper section and share it from here.
marketplace.studio_wallpapers_add_hint: Drag an image here or click to choose one — PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP, up to 40 MB. It lands in your Wallpaper section, and the share form opens right away.
marketplace.studio_prefilled_from: Loaded from {origin} — review the fields, then check and publish.
marketplace.studio_f_name_hint: a-z 0-9 - . — the first published claim owns the name
marketplace.studio_f_description_hint: {count}/500 — what the skill does, one or two sentences
marketplace.studio_f_skill_md_hint: {kb} KB / {max} KB — the instructions the assistant follows, starting with YAML frontmatter
marketplace.studio_f_plugin_json_hint: the Agent Plugins manifest (name, description, version, extensions)
marketplace.studio_f_mcp_json_hint: optional — exactly one server with its "type" ("streamable-http" or "stdio"): an https URL, or a pinned npx/uvx/docker command
marketplace.studio_f_skills_hint: instructions that install together with the plugin — up to 10
marketplace.studio_f_skills_none: None. Skills travel in the package folder as skills/<name>/SKILL.md — drop a folder or import from GitHub to bundle them.
marketplace.studio_f_usage_card_hint: optional — keywords that tell the assistant when the plugin is relevant
marketplace.studio_check_ok: Passes every rule the store checks — ready to publish.
marketplace.studio_preview_note: This is roughly how your entry will look in the store — for everyone, as soon as the checks pass.
marketplace.studio_done_body: The registry received your package and opened its pull request. The automated checks now run; when they pass, it merges and appears in the store on its own.
marketplace.studio_done_live: Live — {name} v{version} is in the marketplace now.
marketplace.studio_done_waited_out: Still not in the feed after several minutes — open the pull request above to see what its checks say.
marketplace.studio_done_watching: Watching the live feed until your package appears — usually a few minutes.
marketplace.studio_done_share_note: Anyone can run this now — it resolves your listing from the public registry.
marketplace.share_subtitle: Anyone using Personal Jarvis will be able to add this wallpaper.
marketplace.share_subtitle_done: Published — it appears in the store once the feed rebuilds.
marketplace.share_consequences: This publishes the picture publicly, under your GitHub name, with no review before it goes live. Only upload something you made or hold the rights to. If you take it down later it disappears from the store — not from machines that already added it.
marketplace.share_identity_blurb: this wallpaper publishes under this name.
marketplace.share_f_title_hint: The store turns this into the wallpaper's address, so make it distinctive.
marketplace.share_f_description_placeholder: Neon rooftops and antenna forests in the rain.
marketplace.share_f_license_note: Only licenses that allow redistribution — the picture is copied onto other people's machines.
marketplace.share_license_cc0_hint: Anyone may use it for anything, no credit required.
marketplace.share_license_ccby_hint: Anyone may use it, as long as they credit you.
marketplace.share_license_ccbysa_hint: As CC BY, and anything built on it carries the same license.
marketplace.share_rights: I made this picture or hold the rights to publish it, and it is legal to share — no copyrighted work of someone else, nothing hateful, and nothing that depicts a real person without their consent.
marketplace.share_footer_done: You can close this — nothing else is needed.
marketplace.share_footer_ready: Nothing is uploaded until you click Publish.
marketplace.share_footer_sign_in: Sign in with GitHub above to publish.
marketplace.share_published_as: Published as {name}. The store rebuilds its list every few minutes — it appears there, and in this app's Marketplace, shortly.
